# Ashke Bhangra Chicago

> Authentic Punjabi Bhangra dance classes in Schaumburg, IL (Chicago area), held weekly at the National India Hub. Classes for all ages, from young children to adults, plus custom wedding choreography.

Ashke Bhangra Chicago teaches traditional Bhangra, the folk dance of Punjab, through weekly classes at the National India Hub — the largest Indian community center in North America. Programs range from beginner fundamentals for young children to performance-ready training for teens and adults, plus private wedding choreography for sangeet, baraat, and reception performances.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.ashkebhangra.com/): Overview of Ashke Bhangra Chicago, class offerings, and location.
- [Book a Class](https://www.ashkebhangra.com/book): Schedule and book a Bhangra class.

## Classes
- Little Sher (ages 5-9): Bhangra basics through games and stories from Punjab.
- Youth Crew (ages 10-16): Performance-ready choreography and prop work (sapp, khunda); compete-ready training.
- Beginner (ages 17+): Foundational footwork, dhamaal, and Punjabi music theory in a low-pressure setting.
- Advanced (ages 17+): Performance training, stamina-building, formation work, and Gidda/Bhangra fusion.
- Wedding Choreography (all ages): Custom private and group routines for sangeet, baraat, and reception performances.

## Location
National India Hub, 930 National Parkway, Schaumburg, IL 60173 — the largest Indian community center in North America.
